claims: NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon, including the first woman and person of color.
NASA's Artemis program aims to establish a long-term presence on the Moon.
NASA's Artemis program aims to prepare for Mars.
Artemis I successfully tested the SLS rocket and Orion capsule uncrewed.
Artemis I was an uncrewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission of the program.
Artemis II sends four astronauts on a 10-day mission to fly around the Moon and return.
Artemis II tests systems for future landings.
Artemis III is targeted to land the first humans on the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis III specifically explores the lunar South Pole.
The Artemis program uses the SLS rocket.
The SLS rocket is the most powerful.
The Artemis program uses the Orion capsule.
The Artemis program includes the Gateway station.
